reports.title: Darling Ingredients Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: Driven by an ongoing focus on deleveraging and confidence in the cash-generating power of its global operations, the company anticipates ending fiscal year 2026 with net debt at or below $3.0 billion, with a leverage ratio below 1.5X.
Reflecting this financial strength, Darling Ingredients reaffirms fiscal year 2026 Combined Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.2-$2.3 billion, positioning the business to carry strong momentum into 2027.
